requiredFindings.evidence: Line 373, under assumed work before day 0: "the X-H3 widening of C and CRC-1 (MH item 25, in review)". Line 791, Unsized: "the X-H3 C revision with CRC-1". The widening row (line 293), the cross-law route, the unbounded-round list (line 498), the reversible-decision row (line 691), and the record-drift bullet (line 822) all name the widening M3-C r8 and CRC-2, and line 822 records that MH r1 and r2 still say "C r7 / CRC-1" because C r7 became the SD-6 amendment. The pinned overnight log's last entry (arch 249d74ab4, sha256 4a7926856b41880ffe6c002dad09ee7c23e37fb8e65d974bd6103f0ba3c84bb7, 315 lines) already says the lead renamed X-H3's successor to "M3-C r8 / CRC-2".
